## Where this can take you

::: {.career-map}
::: {.cm-game}
Estimating the chance of a claim
:::
::: {.cm-job}
**Data analyst / data scientist**

Builds models from claims, health and customer data to predict what happens next.
:::

::: {.cm-game}
Setting the premium
:::
::: {.cm-job}
**Pricing actuary**

Sets the price of car, home, travel, health and life insurance.
:::

::: {.cm-game}
Surviving a run of bad luck
:::
::: {.cm-job}
**Risk and capital actuary**

Makes sure insurers, banks and super funds can still pay out in a bad year, including for regulators and government.
:::
:::

::: {.cm-more}
[And less obvious paths:]{.cm-lead} [Superannuation]{.chip} [Consulting]{.chip} [Health]{.chip} [Climate risk]{.chip} [Banking]{.chip} [Sports analytics]{.chip} [Tech]{.chip}
:::

[The pathway: an accredited degree, then professional qualification through the Actuaries Institute (AUS), Society of Actuaries (SOA, U.S. and international), and the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA, U.K.).]{.source-line}

::: {.notes}
About 2 min. Point back at each part of the game: "When you guessed how many phones would break, that's data science. When you set the premium, that's pricing. When you hoped for no bad luck, that's risk and capital."
:::
